game.name: Grand Theft Auto V
game.rules:
• **Timing** is done using **RTA** (Real Time Attack).  Time without loads is only available when submitting a run because of an issue with speedrun.com. Please only fill in the "time with loads" field.

• **Video footage of the entire run must be submitted** as permanent storage. (which means no twitch past broadcast, you need to highlight your run for it to stay).

• Your run must always be publicly viewable by everybody, which means **no private videos on Youtube** or **subscriber only vod function on Twitch**.

• **No changes** to the game settings that are **not possible to set from the in-game menu** can be made (this means you can't edit settings.xml).

• Entering a **Cheat Code** (through any method) or having **any kind of mod installed**, even if they're just visual, **will invalidate your run.**

• **Loading a savefile that wasn't made in the current run will immediately invalidate your run**, even if you load back into a correct one afterwards.

• You aren't allowed to use **any script that does multiple, a sequence**
**of or alternating inputs**.

• If the game natively allows an action to be performed by pressing only one button, you may rebind it with an external program to a different button or even a different device with just one input as well, in this case it doesn't matter how you achieve this. (Prime example is special ability which is normally 2 buttons on controller, you are allowed to use it with just one because it is possible to do this on keyboard). Doing this you need to make sure that one button press is still only doing one action. (For example the button you are powering with can't at the same do something different like changing weapons etc.).

• **Using the 500k 'Preorder DLC' is prohibited** (http://imgur.com/a/aSCT8). You are not allowed to do anything that is not possible without the bonus. This still means you can go under 500k in some cases because hospital bills are dynamic based on how much money you have. Runs will be evaluated whether they turn out the same without the preorder bonus.

• **Any form of NG+ is forbidden**, including but not limited to: Carrying over the state of the map from a previous save file, having to only mission fail twice before you can skip shooting the guard in Prologue, or carrying over the slipstream effect from street races.

• **Any strat that requires an active internet connection is banned**. This includes but is not limited to: Using the Rockstar companion 'Ifruit app' on your real life smart device to affect your gameplay(even if just visually), trying to enter and exit the rockstar creator to force a random switch.

• **Gaining access to the Director Mode Menu in freeroam or during missions is forbidden** unless explicitly allowed in the Category-specific rules.

• **Changing the patch you're playing on during the run is not allowed.**


• **Having multiple copies of the game open at the same time is not allowed** unless explicitly allowed in the Category-specific rules.

• If you are using a vega 56/64 based GPU, the ingame setting "Reflection MSAA" is bugged and turning it on makes the game look like you changed a setting that you aren't allowed to. We advise(though not required) you turn that option off in that case to make our verification process easier(https://i.imgur.com/SrX17Xu.png)

categories.name: All Letters
categories.rules:
**Start Timer** on the first frame of seeing Michael at the therapist after Prologue. This can either be achieved by playing through prologue(gameplay must be shown) or by loading an autosave created after Prologue.  
**Stop Timer** on the mission passed screen of 'A Starlet in Vinewood', which is unlocked after you collect the 50th letter scrap.  

Letter scraps become collectable after completing the missions:
Prologue
Franklin & Lamar
Repossession

categories.name: All Peyote Plants
categories.rules:

You have to confirm you've gotten all 27 peyotes by either showing the 27/27peyote collected popup in your recording or by navigating to it in the stats menu.

categories.name: All Spaceship Parts
categories.rules:
**PC Rules:**  
Starting your run off this savefile is required:  
https://www.dropbox.com/s/9jpzd4z5wk3iyin/SGTA50000?dl=0  

The entire loading process of the savefile must be recorded and shown, this includes selecting it in the menu, not just the loading itself.   
Upon loading into the save you shall immediatly start the run. Unnecessary waiting, receiving a text or doing anything else that influences your run will make it invalid.  

**Console Rules:**  
You may create your own savefile to start from, it has to be made right after Friends Reunited. Weapon wise you may only have those that you naturally get throughout the playthrough with the only exception being that Michael and Franklin can have C4.  

**Start Timer** on the first Frame after skipping the Cutscene at the start of Fame or Shame. (after the blackscreen disappeared)  
**Stop Timer** on the first Frame after skipping the Cutscene on The Final Frontier

This category requires the completion of the **100% checklist** in-game: 
69 / 69 Missions  
42 / 61 Hobbies & Pasttime  
20 / 58 Strangers & Freaks  
14 / 60 Random Events  
16 / 30 Misc	
Proof of 100% completion has to be included in the video, either by opening your statistics page or by navigating through your phone in offline mode.  
If 100% was achieved by completing an activity **after** the final mission, your timer will stop when the stat page for 100% completion is shown.

categories.name: All Missions
categories.rules:
This category requires the completion of all main missions and all strangers and freaks missions (all these missions are listed on the social club checklist except for What Lies Beneath).

**Start Timer** on the text "Ludendorff, North Yankton, nine years ago".  
**Stop Timer** at the end of whichever mission is completed last. More specifically, on the first frame of the mission pass screen of that mission. If the final completed mission does not have a mission passed screen, then stop the timer after skipping the final cutscene of the mission.

**Additional limitations:**

• No fast travel via taxi service. Taxis can be stolen like normal vehicles.  
• No failed mission skips (Failing a mission three times to skip to the next checkpoint).    
• Ending C (The Third Way) must be chosen.

categories.name: Director Mode
categories.rules: • Gaining access to the Director Mode Menu is allowed in these Categories.

categories.name: Any% NG+
categories.rules:
**General Rules For All Individual Levels**  
 Each run must be started from the mission replay menu unless stated otherwise in the 
notes specific for the mission. Runs that start from any kind of 'failed' screen or a restart functionality will be considered invalid. You have to show how you are selecting and loading into the Mission Replay.
Using exploits to modify the checkpoint variable is not allowed.  

Rules for Hobby Activities:  
Your recording has to start before interacting with the race to ensure the race hasn't been restarted or started from a failed screen.  


Unless otherwise stated in the notes specific for the mission:  
**Start Timer** at the first frame after the mission loads. This will likely be the start of a cutscene.  
**Stop Timer** the instant the 'Mission Passed' appears on screen.  

 **Use the 100% save file in the resources section** to do your runs. This is not required, but it gives you all the possible time saving upgrades.  

**Additional limitations:**  
• No fast travel via taxi service. Taxis can be stolen like normal vehicles.  
• No failed mission skips (Failing a mission three times and pressing space and enter).  
• Having access to the Director Mode Menu and bringing additional Vehicles into the Mission/Hobby is allowed.

categories.name: Segments
categories.rules:
**PC Rules:**

You are required to start off your run on the savefiles provided below, unless you're running Trevor%, then just start New Game or Countryside where savefile does not matter for a run.

https://drive.google.com/file/d/12nWd6Rg_QPnNMIyT-OB2vGRNuvWPnxi4/view?usp=sharing


The entire process of selecting a savefile in a menu and loading must be recorded and shown (Not applicable to Trevor%, include at least a bit of new game loading).

Upon loading into the savefile you shall immediatly start the run. Unnecessary waiting, receiving a text or doing anything else that influences your run will make it invalid.

**Console Rules:**

You may create your own savefiles to start from. To ensure fairness across different runners you need to make sure you aren't using any weapons or vehicles that aren't allowed for any given Segment. The sheet below shows which weapons you are allowed to have at the start of each Segment. Whatever you acquire during the run you are of course allowed to use aswell.
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1803Vo7cVPE9JbymGnLi_Idb98gtPxDhL1RnXyjz9DkY/edit?usp=sharing

Showing the selection and loading of a savefile is not necessary, but very much welcome.

**Rules for all platforms:**

Unless otherwise stated at the bottom of this rule page each run will start on the 1st visible frame after skipping the cutscene of the first mission thus you are REQUIRED to skip it, you cannot let the cutscene complete naturally.

The only segment that can be restarted from a Mission Failed screen is Trevor%, for any other segment you must reload the savefile.

You may submit any Segment run completed in a full run as long as it follows all of the rules below:

- You may not be intentionally slower in a previous segment to gain advantage, for example: getting texts or moving mission order around
- You cannot do any unordinary things before the segment starts, for example: having checkpoint transferring glitch (om0) prepared beforehand
- Your submission must include gameplay part from the last Mission Passed screen till start of a segment you wish to submit, for example: You must include whole drive to Minor Turbulence if you wish to submit Paleto Score segment done in a full run (Not applicable to Trevor%, include at least a bit of new game loading).

**Segments follow Classic ruleset with checkpoint transferring glitches allowed (om0):**

- No fast travel via taxi service. Taxis can be stolen like normal vehicles.
- No failed mission skips (Failing a mission three times to skip to the next checkpoint).
- You are allowed to perform checkpoint transferring glitches (om0) during the segment

**Additional Rules for this segment:**

categories.name: Golf
categories.rules:
**Start Timer** on the first frame of your character at the first tee.   
**Stop Timer** the instant that the hole #9 score comes up e.g Birdie, Par etc.

You are not allowed to place a car(or any other object that has collision) on the Golf course prior to starting your run.  
You may not start your run from continuing after a previous run, you need to exit & enter instead.

**Stop Timer** when you have completed all 50 stunt jumps and see 'Stunt Jump Completed - All Stunt Jumps Completed'.

categories.name: A Close Shave
categories.rules:
**Start Timer** on the first frame of seeing Michael at the therapist after Prologue. This can either be achieved by playing through prologue(gameplay must be shown) or by loading an autosave created after Prologue.  
**Stop Timer** at the final 50/50 'Under The Bridge' or the final 15/15 'Knife Flight', whichever you finish second.
There is a known bug where the text popup for completing bridges doesn't show. If this happens on your last objective you have to show on the stat page (https://i.imgur.com/hlCfB0f.png) that you have completed all bridges and knife flights, aswell as the audio cue for completing bridges/knife flights has to be hearable.

categories.rules:
**PC Rules:**
Starting your run off this savefile is required: 
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1TMLvszeUqMIY-opZIf4bPjZDwJh2A_Kk/view?usp=drive_link
The entire loading process of the savefile must be recorded and shown, this includes selecting it in the menu, not just the loading itself.

**Console Rules:**
You may create your own savefile to start from.
Limitations:

- Game has to be completed  
- Time of day has to be 10:30 pm
- Only allowed saved Vehicle in either Garage is a Stock Bati  
- Recreate Franklin's and his Buffalo's position accurately to this: https://i.imgur.com/wTYoh0f.png

**Start Timer** on the first Frame that isn't a loading Screen.
**Stop Timer** on 1st Place(or whatever place you got) Screen of the final Race.

Complete all Street, Offroad & Sea Shark Races. (there are 5 street, 6 offroad, and 4 sea shark races, you can finish these races in any place)

You may not switch characters until the first race has been completed unless it is done via a hangout.

Classic Rules apply, which are:

• No fast travel via taxi service. Taxis can be stolen like normal vehicles.
• No failed mission skips (Failing a mission three times to skip to the next checkpoint).

categories.rules:
**Start Timer** on the text "Ludendorff, North Yankton, nine years ago".
**Stop Timer** on the Mission Pass screen of Unknowing the Truth.

Classic Rules apply, which are:

• Transferring Checkpoint progress from one mission to another is forbidden.
• No fast travel via taxi service. Taxis can be stolen like normal vehicles.
• No failed mission skips (Failing a mission three times to skip to the next checkpoint).

Multiple copies of the game can be open at the same time. If done, runners must make an honest attempt to show video of all copies of the game.

categories.name: Segments
categories.rules:
**PC Rules:**

You are required to start off your run on the savefiles provided below, unless you're running Trevor%, then just start New Game or Countryside where savefile does not matter for a run.

https://drive.google.com/file/d/12nWd6Rg_QPnNMIyT-OB2vGRNuvWPnxi4/view?usp=sharing


The entire process of selecting a savefile in a menu and loading must be recorded and shown (Not applicable to Trevor%, include at least a bit of new game loading).

Upon loading into the savefile you shall immediatly start the run. Unnecessary waiting, receiving a text or doing anything else that influences your run will make it invalid.

**Console Rules:**

You may create your own savefiles to start from. To ensure fairness across different runners you need to make sure you aren't using any weapons or vehicles that aren't allowed for any given Segment. The sheet below shows which weapons you are allowed to have at the start of each Segment. Whatever you acquire during the run you are of course allowed to use aswell.
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1803Vo7cVPE9JbymGnLi_Idb98gtPxDhL1RnXyjz9DkY/edit?usp=sharing

Showing the selection and loading of a savefile is not necessary, but very much welcome.

**Rules for all platforms:**

Unless otherwise stated at the bottom of this rule page each run will start on the 1st visible frame after skipping the cutscene of the first mission thus you are REQUIRED to skip it, you cannot let the cutscene complete naturally.

The only segment that can be restarted from a Mission Failed screen is Trevor%, for any other segment you must reload the savefile.

You may submit any Segment run completed in a full run as long as it follows all of the rules below:

- You may not be intentionally slower in a previous segment to gain advantage, for example: getting texts or moving mission order around
- You cannot do any unordinary things before the segment starts, for example: having checkpoint transferring glitch (om0) prepared beforehand
- Your submission must include gameplay part from the last Mission Passed screen till start of a segment you wish to submit, for example: You must include whole drive to Minor Turbulence if you wish to submit Paleto Score segment done in a full run (Not applicable to Trevor%, include at least a bit of new game loading).

**Segments follow Classic ruleset with checkpoint transferring glitches allowed (om0):**

- No fast travel via taxi service. Taxis can be stolen like normal vehicles.
- No failed mission skips (Failing a mission three times to skip to the next checkpoint).
- You are allowed to perform checkpoint transferring glitches (om0) during the segment

**Additional Rules for this segment:**

categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
**General Rules For All Individual Levels**  
 Each run must be started from the mission replay menu unless stated otherwise in the 
notes specific for the mission. Runs that start from any kind of 'failed' screen or a restart functionality will be considered invalid. You have to show how you are selecting and loading into the Mission Replay.
Using exploits to modify the checkpoint variable is not allowed.

Rules for Hobby Activities:  
Your recording has to start before interacting with the race to ensure the race hasn't been restarted or started from a failed screen.  
You may also not use any glitches that allow you to do these activities with vehicles unintended for them.  


Unless otherwise stated in the notes specific for the mission:  
**Start Timer** at the first frame after the mission loads. This will likely be the start of a cutscene.  
**Stop Timer** the instant the 'Mission Passed' appears on screen.  

 **Use the 100% save file in the resources section** to do your runs. This is not required, but it gives you all the possible time saving upgrades.  

**Additional limitations:**  
• No fast travel via taxi service. Taxis can be stolen like normal vehicles.  
• No failed mission skips (Failing a mission three times and pressing space and enter).  
• Having access to the Director Mode Menu and bringing additional Vehicles into the Mission/Hobby is forbidden. (this includes using Cars stored in a garage) - If a race requires you to bring a  vehicle to start it, you are allowed to bring any vehicle you want.

games.name: Grand Theft Auto V
games.rules:
• **Timing** is done using **RTA** (Real Time Attack).  Time without loads is only available when submitting a run because of an issue with speedrun.com. Please only fill in the "time with loads" field.

• **Video footage of the entire run must be submitted** as permanent storage. (which means no twitch past broadcast, you need to highlight your run for it to stay).

• Your run must always be publicly viewable by everybody, which means **no private videos on Youtube** or **subscriber only vod function on Twitch**.

• **No changes** to the game settings that are **not possible to set from the in-game menu** can be made (this means you can't edit settings.xml).

• Entering a **Cheat Code** (through any method) or having **any kind of mod installed**, even if they're just visual, **will invalidate your run.**

• **Loading a savefile that wasn't made in the current run will immediately invalidate your run**, even if you load back into a correct one afterwards.

• You aren't allowed to use **any script that does multiple, a sequence**
**of or alternating inputs**.

• If the game natively allows an action to be performed by pressing only one button, you may rebind it with an external program to a different button or even a different device with just one input as well, in this case it doesn't matter how you achieve this. (Prime example is special ability which is normally 2 buttons on controller, you are allowed to use it with just one because it is possible to do this on keyboard). Doing this you need to make sure that one button press is still only doing one action. (For example the button you are powering with can't at the same do something different like changing weapons etc.).

• **Using the 500k 'Preorder DLC' is prohibited** (http://imgur.com/a/aSCT8). You are not allowed to do anything that is not possible without the bonus. This still means you can go under 500k in some cases because hospital bills are dynamic based on how much money you have. Runs will be evaluated whether they turn out the same without the preorder bonus.

• **Any form of NG+ is forbidden**, including but not limited to: Carrying over the state of the map from a previous save file, having to only mission fail twice before you can skip shooting the guard in Prologue, or carrying over the slipstream effect from street races.

• **Any strat that requires an active internet connection is banned**. This includes but is not limited to: Using the Rockstar companion 'Ifruit app' on your real life smart device to affect your gameplay(even if just visually), trying to enter and exit the rockstar creator to force a random switch.

• **Gaining access to the Director Mode Menu in freeroam or during missions is forbidden** unless explicitly allowed in the Category-specific rules.

• **Changing the patch you're playing on during the run is not allowed.**


• **Having multiple copies of the game open at the same time is not allowed** unless explicitly allowed in the Category-specific rules.

• If you are using a vega 56/64 based GPU, the ingame setting "Reflection MSAA" is bugged and turning it on makes the game look like you changed a setting that you aren't allowed to. We advise(though not required) you turn that option off in that case to make our verification process easier(https://i.imgur.com/SrX17Xu.png)

values.name: All Spaceship Parts
values.rules:
**PC Rules:**

Starting your run off this savefile is required:

https://www.dropbox.com/s/9jpzd4z5wk3iyin/SGTA50000?dl=0



The entire loading process of the savefile must be recorded and shown, this includes selecting it in the menu, not just the loading itself.

Upon loading into the save you shall immediatly start the run. Unnecessary waiting, receiving a text or doing anything else that influences your run will make it invalid.



**Console Rules:**

You may create your own savefile to start from, it has to be made right after Friends Reunited. Weapon wise you may only have those that you naturally get throughout the playthrough with the only exception being that Michael and Franklin can have C4.

values.name: All Wildlife Photography
values.rules:
**Start Timer** on the first frame of seeing Michael at the therapist after Prologue. This can either be achieved by playing through prologue(gameplay must be shown) or by loading an autosave created after Prologue.

**Stop Timer** on the screen that says 20/20 wildlife photographs taken or after sending the last photograph.

It is possible for the text popup to not pop up after quickly sending photographs in succession. If this happens on the last photograph, then you must show on the statistics page that you have completed 20/20 photographs.

This category requires the completion of the **100% checklist** in-game: 69 / 69 Missions
42 / 61 Hobbies & Pasttime
20 / 58 Strangers & Freaks
14 / 60 Random Events
16 / 30 Misc
Proof of 100% completion has to be included in the video, either by opening your statistics page or by navigating through your phone in offline mode.
If 100% was achieved by completing an activity **after** the final mission, your timer will stop when the stat page for 100% completion is shown.
